send: echo ===LIVE-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep -E 'openbook-live|fs_mgr.*(wiped|ormat)|vold.*(ormat|encrypt)' | head -n 60; echo ===LIVE-END===

echo ===STORAGE-BEGIN===; cat /proc/partitions; su 0 ls -l /dev/block/by-name; df -k /data /metadata; getprop | grep -E 'ro.boot.(openbook|slot_suffix|boot_part_uuid|verifiedbootstate|selinux)|ro.crypto'; echo ===STORAGE-END===
su 0 sh -c 'echo openbook-live-marker-$(date +%s) > /data/local/tmp/openbook-marker; sync'; echo MARKER=$(su 0 cat /data/local/tmp/openbook-marker)
i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 600 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)

echo ===STATE-BEGIN===; getprop | grep -E 'init.svc.(surfaceflinger|zygote|zygote64|bootanim|vendor.openbook)|sys.boot_completed|sys.system_server|vendor.anybook.gpu|ro.hardware.(egl|vulkan|gralloc|hwcomposer)'; dumpsys SurfaceFlinger 2>&1 | head -n 30; dumpsys window displays 2>&1 | head -n 20; echo ===STATE-END===
echo ===DMESG-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | gzip | base64; echo ===DMESG-END===
echo ===LOGCAT-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | gzip | base64; echo ===LOGCAT-END===
